jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
¡Hola! Te estábamos esperando.

Sí, sí, a ti, personas con ganas de comenzar nuevas aventuras profesionales y con curiosidad por saber cómo sería un futuro en BBVA Technology. Sabemos que te apasiona la tecnología, ¿pero a que además te gustaría trabajar en un sitio donde el aprendizaje constante y la compartición del conocimiento es parte de nuestro ADN? #shareyourbrain 🧠

Somos BBVA Technology, compañía del Grupo BBVA experta en Ingeniería de software y nuevas tecnologías. Trabajamos a nivel global, desde nuestras sedes en Madrid, Barcelona y Bilbao, con el objetivo de ser protagonistas principales de la #transformacióndigital de BBVA.

Somos un equipo diverso e inclusivo. Inconformistas y comprometidos 🌍. Impulsamos nuestro plan de igualdad con nuestras referentes, tenemos un plan de inclusión de la discapacidad, hacemos encuentros por la diversidad con nuestros embajadores, potenciamos la economía circular y disfrutamos con el voluntariado.

Llegarás y sentirás el buen rollo... nuestros empleados han puntuado con un 9.06 el compañerismo y buen ambiente que tenemos. Y además, por qué ocultarlo… se nos da muy bien celebrar y montar buenos saraos 😎. Si te gusta todo lo que has leído hasta el momento, continúa para ver si hacemos match 💙

🔎¿Qué estamos buscando?
• Al menos 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend de SW en Java (11) y spring boot.
• Experiencia trabajando con arquitectura de microservicios.
• Experiencia en entorno agile.
• CI/CD con jenkins pero valoraremos si has trabajado con otras.
• Maven.
• Git como repositorio de codigo.

✨Qué esperamos de ti✨
• Que tengas pensamiento innovador y creativo con un especial interés en el mundo IT.
• Que seas un/a jugador/a de equipo capaz de hacer valer tus ideas, nos encantan las personas proactivas y colaboradoras.
• La orientación a resultados es una parte fundamental de nuestro trabajo, si te gustan los retos este es tu sitio.

Valoramos positivamente:
• TDD y Buenas prácticas en desarrollo.

💙Qué tenemos para ti:
• 2000€ anuales para seguir formándote dentro de tu horario laboral y alimentar esa curiosidad infinita que tanto nos gusta!! Tenemos un modelo de formación que te aseguramos que te va a gustar y mucho.
• Creemos en tu desarrollo profesional. Lo cuidamos con un modelo de talento donde podrás evolucionar a través de la experiencia, logros y habilidades que irás adquiriendo dentro de BBVA technology.
• Contrato indefinido en una compañía 100% digital, tecnológica y en un grupo financiero líder internacional.
• ¡30 días de vacaciones al año! Jornada intensiva los viernes y dos meses de verano.
• Un modelo de teletrabajo perfecto para la conciliación y disfrute de tu tiempo libre, por eso ofrecemos un modelo híbrido porque el trabajo en remoto nos gusta y mucho. Además, tenemos horario flexible de entrada y salida para que seas tú quien decida cómo organizar tu tiempo.
• Ayudas para familiares con discapacidad gracias a nuestro Programa Plan Familia de la Fundación Adecco.
• Tendrás ayuda alimentaria y ayuda a gastos de teletrabajo.
• Dispondrás de un sistema de retribución flexible (transporte, seguro médico de Sanitas, Movistar...).
• Ser una compañía 100% BBVA tiene sus ventajas como poder disfrutar de todos los productos financieros con condiciones especiales para empleados del Grupo (hipotecas, préstamos, tarjetas, seguros, etc.).
• ¿Te preguntas si tendrás visibilidad? Sí. Favorecemos que puedas asistir a eventos tanto nacionales como internacionales, así como a organizar los tuyos propios open company. Podrás participar en las iniciativas y actividades de la compañía. Y por supuesto, nuestras redes sociales están a disposición de todo el mundo para mostrar lo que vales.

Entonces… ¿Qué nos dices? ¿Hacemos match? 😏

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer - Golang
jobs_results.description:
Software Engineer - Backend Developer - Golang
@ BlueThrone This role is not just a job; it's a calling for those who dare to lead, inspire, and transform the digital landscape. Join us, and let's chart the course to a future written in the stars of success.
• Remote, work from anywhere *

About BlueThrone

Embark on a transformative journey with BlueThrone, a pioneer in the mobile app domain. We specialize in turning promising B2C mobile apps into market leaders, boasting over 49.5 million organic downloads and 4.6 million monthly active users. With a mission to propel iOS and Android applications to new heights, we've achieved a remarkable ARR organically in just 25 months, exemplifying sustainable growth and innovation. Our team, rich in tech entrepreneurship and mobile marketing expertise, thrives in an environment that values agility, a growth mindset, flexibility, creativity, and tangible outcomes. At BlueThrone, your career is more than a job—it's a journey towards excellence... in an innovative culture where high performance is as valued as innovation.
The Opportunity

Join us at BlueThrone as a Senior Backend Developer / Software Engineer, where your expertise plays a crucial role in evolving our legacy systems and pioneering new technologies. This is a unique opportunity to apply your skills in Golang and cloud services in real-world applications, directly impacting our strategic direction. You'll lead the charge in building resilient, scalable systems from the ground up, transforming our technological landscape. Here, your work is not just about writing code—it's about laying the foundation for future innovations and driving the success of a company at the forefront of the digital domain. Dive into a role where your passion for technology and innovation shapes the future of our company and the industry at large.

Your Mission

∙Strategic System Architecture: Design and implement robust backend architectures that support scalable and resilient systems, ensuring they align with our strategic objectives and can evolve with industry trends.

∙ Legacy System Enhancement: Proactively identify opportunities for optimizing and refactoring legacy codebases, improving performance, and reducing technical debt without compromising system stability.

∙ Innovative System Development: Lead the charge in developing a new, state-of-the-art system from scratch, employing advanced programming techniques and technologies to set new industry benchmarks.

∙ Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with cross-disciplinary teams to align the backend technology with overall business goals, ensuring our core platform supports and drives strategic objectives.

Your Expedition Toolkit

∙ Expertise: Profound command over Golang with a 5+ years of hands-on experience in developing high-performance, production-level apps.

∙Database Mastery: Extensive experience with PostgreSQL, with the ability to design complex schemas, optimize queries for performance, and implement best practices for database security and integrity.

∙Cloud Engineering: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, with expertise in architecting and managing scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native applications.

∙ DevOps and Infrastructure: Comprehensive understanding of DevOps principles, practices, and tools, including CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

∙Exceptional Communicator: Ability to articulate technical visions and challenges to stakeholders at all levels, facilitating clear and effective collaboration in a supportive environment.

∙ Energetic and Positive Leadership: Inspire your team with a can-do attitude, encouraging innovation, risk-taking, and collective problem-solving.

∙ Strategic Thinker: You not only excel in technical execution but also contribute to strategic discussions, helping shape the future direction of our tech & products.

∙ You are a strong communicator, with a professional Proficiency in English. Knowladge of Russian or/and Hebrew is advantage.

Why Join BlueThrone?

Join us in a role that's more than a job - it's a chance to be part of a transformative mission, propelling mobile apps to unparalleled success. We offer not just a career but a lifestyle, blending professional growth with personal well-being.

🚀 Innovative Culture: Be part of a company that's redefining the mobile app market, backed by a business model that blends professional growth with personal well-being.

🏝 Work from Anywhere: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere, with flexible hours that suit your lifestyle.

💻 Impactful Work: Your role directly contributes to the company's growth and success in the fast-paced world of mobile app acquisitions.

🏆 Collaborative Environment: Join a team of talented professionals in a supportive atmosphere that fosters creativity and innovation.

🃏 Career Development: At BlueThrone, personal and professional growth isn't just a possibility – it's a priority.

🌍 Global Reach: Work with a diverse team of 50 exceptional talents spread across over 19 countries, expanding your professional network and cultural understanding.

Ready to embark on a journey with BlueThrone? Apply Now

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
What will you do?
• You will be involved in the implementation and development process of the backend systems for an important e-commerce customer.
• You will work in an international environment, together with our German colleagues.

What's your story?
• At least 5+ years of experience as backend developer with Java
• Solid experience using Spring Boot for building RESTful interfaces
• Solid experience in Building Docker Images
• Good sense for software quality, testing and engineering processes
• Good English skills, written and spoken
• Excellent team-player in an agile working environment

Nice To Have (if Applicable)
• Experience with Java frontend frameworks Swing and JavaFX
• German skills, written and spoken

Benefits
• Permanent contract
• Flexible working hours (you decide how to organize your day to day!)
• Hybrid work mode (work from home up to 80% of the time, having the rest to meet you colleagues at the office!)
• You will be part of a fast growing company, being part... of a great team
• Competitive salary
• Flexible retribution
• Medical insurance
• Agile working methods
• Training and Development: we have a clear focus on technical innovation, but we don't forget the personal growth!

https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/socrpub8itQ?rel=0&showinfo=0&color=white&cc_load_policy=1&hl=es

Contact

Isabel Mateo

Otto Group Solution Provider Spain S.L.

Calle del Conde de Peñalver 38, 1ª planta | 28006 Madrid

Isabel.Mateo@ottogroup.com

¿Quiénes somos?

More than just IT

OSP (Otto Group Solution Provider) is an IT service provider for retail and logistics with headquarters in Dresden. We live our passion for IT in an appreciative, trusting work environment. What drives us is the idea of working together as a team to achieve great things for our customers.

We rely on the personal responsibility and willingness to learn of our employees, on modern technologies and high quality in software development. Agile working, transparent decisions, a lively feedback culture and collegial cooperation make us successful.

We are active for customers inside and outside the Otto Group. With over 450 employees at several German and international locations, we have been developing flexible software and BI solutions since 1991 and are thus shaping the shopping worlds of tomorrow. We are part of the Otto Group and share a value system that focuses on responsible and sustainable action

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
About Qbeast

Qbeast is a spin-off of the Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC) with an innovative approach to Big Data by providing great insights while accessing only the minimum quantity of data. We provide the necessary infrastructure and tools for companies to ingest, transform and analyze large amounts of data in seconds.

We are an international team based in Barcelona. We have successfully raised a significant amount of investments that allow us to comfortably fund our research and development efforts, ensuring the best experience for our customers.

We provide a hybrid remote work model and offer flexible working hours.

The Opportunity

We are currently seeking an individual to join our team and work on our newly developed Universal Storage Engine (USE) product. This role will involve tasks related to our critical storage engine format designed for data lakehouse. You will collaborate closely with the rest of the team to implement unique features that are not currently... available in the market.

As a key piece of our tech team, you’ll be doing:
• Maintaining and adding new features to our storage engine format (Java/Scala and some parts in Rust)
• Updating and maintaining our regression benchmark process to test performance and stability
• Boost our observability features to include more plots, metrics and possibly alerts
• Implement support for other open table formats (Iceberg for example)
• Overall product quality including continuous perf evaluation
• Other things of your interest, we’re a startup so there is lot to be done

To Be Part Of The Team, We Require
• A minimum of five years of professional experience
• Bachelor of Computer Science or equivalent degree
• Strong knowledge of data structure and I/O operations
• Experience running Spark in production
• English proficient at work
• Willing to come to the office for 2 days a week
• Organized, autonomous, and proactive
• Willing to keep learning, sharing knowledge with others
• A great team player, helping others when needed

Our tech stack
• We are developing a revolutionary technology that will power data analytics for different processing frameworks, starting with Apache Spark
• Our infrastructure is managed with Kubernetes, Terraform, and GitHub
• We deliver a full-stack platform built on Typescript, Rust, Java, Scala, and Python

Benefits
• Market conditions according to your background and experience
• Nice office in Barcelona on the Eixample neighbourhood
• Flexible Compensation (transportation, restaurant, kindergarten)
• Health insurance with Adeslas

Our Commitment
• The good things of a startup: we are building a work culture, not only revolutionary software
• You will work with talented, nice people
• The best coffee you will find
• Qbeast will be a company of reference in Data Engineering
• We are always learning about tech and business

If you share our dream of changing the world of Big Data, we must meet soon!

Spin-off of the Barcelona Supercomputing Center

jobs_results.title: Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
🚀 Join Our Team at Agentero!

We’re on the lookout for a talented Backend Engineer!

At Agentero we believe in simple and smart solutions for complex problems.

We are building cutting-edge technology to help insurance agents serve their customers more effectively and help them grow their businesses. We do so through a data-driven platform that provides insurance agents with market access to digital carriers.

Agentero is a remote-first Silicon Valley startup with a top-talent team spread across Spain and the US. We've raised a $13.5M Series A, bringing our total funding to over $20M with participation of top investors like Foundation Capital (Uber, Netflix) or USV (Twitter, MongoDB) and Mundi Ventures (WeFox). It’s going to be huge! This is just the start…

👤 We are looking for:

We're in search of a skilled Backend Engineer who will play a vital role in shaping Agentero's technological landscape. This role entails crafting innovative solutions, coding with precision, and... collaborating across teams to drive our software projects forward.

📣 Being a Software Engineer at Agentero means:
• You will write clean, robust, and performant software using Go Programming Language.
• You will collaborate with our Product team to find creative solutions and deliver new features that delight our customers.
• You will help us build a culture of engineering excellence that you are proud to belong to.

🛠 You would say you have:
• At least 5 years of relevant software development experience using any modern programming language.
• Ownership of your work and enjoy the autonomy of being able to manage your projects across the different stages of software development: design, implementation, release management, and production.
• Great team player: humble, empathetic, open mindset.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

💎 What’s in it for you:
• Competitive Salary (45K-60K depending on experience).
• Stock Options. Own a part of the company.
• Budget for training and development.
• Home office set-up budget.
• Restaurant and transport cards through Cobee (ES only).
• Private Health Insurance.
• Flexible working hours in a remote-first environment.
• Team offsites in different locations, like Mexico, Miami, Nashville, and more!

🗓️ What to expect from our recruitment process:

We know the recruitment process can be tedious, so here’s what ours looks like:
• Initial Call with the People Team to get to know you.
• Role Specific Call with our CTO to dive deeper into the nitty gritty.

jobs_results.description:
- Remote Spain based -

Our Technology

Our Technology Team is made up of many small multi-discipline, cross-functional, autonomous teams, organised into business domains implementing highly independent self-contained systems. We build sophisticated solutions to solve highly complex business problems; we do so whilst simultaneously transforming our platform and supporting a business at scale. We use a wide range of technologies and cloud services to power our proprietary platform, and we seek simplicity by using the best tools available for the job. We value ownership, collaboration and encourage our people to work across boundaries. We embrace change, we grow, mature, take on new ideas whilst holding onto what is important to us.

What you will do:
• Plan, develop and improve the gambling platform with a very high degree of ownership (“you built it, you run it”) on a continuous delivery basis
• Design and implement interfaces to other high availability systems
• Collaborate closely... with software architects, product owners and stakeholders
• Be part of a highly collaborative agile process
• Use your experience and knowledge to support and make architectural decisions together with the software architects, play a part in the selection of new technologies, and promote knowledge transfer both within your team and between teams

Who you are:
• Experienced with OOP, design patterns, Java 11+ (CDI, JSF, EJB, JAX-RS), databases (NoSQL) and data structures
• Have excellent understanding of complex software architecture
• Familiar with cloud technologies like Kubernetes, Docker
• Experienced with tools such as IntelliJ IDEA, Git, Maven
• Highly familiar with agile development and continuous delivery
• Ensure high quality standards. Awareness of Clean code practices, as well as others (SOLID, KISS, DRY, etc.)

What's in it for you:
• A dynamic and highly motivated international team of skilled and experienced professionals
• An open culture defined by passion for developing software, fun and mutual respect.
• State of the Art technology environment and Continuous Delivery process
• Continuous learning based on a training & development program

Benefits:
• Private Healthcare
• 25 days per annum of annual leave, plus 14 bank holidays – that can be taken at any time during the year subject to management approval.
• Remote work allowance (equal to 50 EUR/ gross monthly)
• Educational opportunities
• Well-being support

Come as you are. And develop yourself.

We are a team of over 45 nations and many talents. Together we create a truly authentic and resilient workplace where everyone can be themselves.

We are an inclusive company. We value diverse approaches and multiple points of view. Diversity creates better ideas. That's why we build a culture where differences are valued.

Here everyone is welcome, regardless of who they are and where they come from. So that opportunities can grow for everyone

jobs_results.description:
About Fundcraft

fundcraft is a fast-growing, tech-powered fund services provider, aiming to revolutionise the fund management industry through our proprietary platform. Our dedicated team of financial experts, lawyers, tech developers, and data scientists are fully committed to turning the organisation to a leading fund services firm, in Europe and beyond. The company was founded in 2020 and has been experiencing rapid growth, already employing more than 75 professionals in two countries.

About The Role

Key responsibilities:
• You will collaborate with a cross-functional scrum team that develops in Python, ReactJS, Docker and AWS Cloud technologies
• You will design, build and maintain API’s, services and systems across fundcraft’s engineering teams
• You will collaborate in improving engineering standards, tooling and processes

How you will be successful in your application

Must-Have Experience / Qualifications
• You have at least 1 year of experience working as a Backend... Engineer
• Experience in the development, deployment, and maintenance of web-based technology applications with Python or the ability and interest in working with it
• Devotion to clean and well-done code
• Spanish: fluent level (spoken and written)
• English: fluent level (spoken and written)

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with other elements of fundcraft's tech stack: Django, Celery, OpenAPI, Javascript, React, PostgreSQL, AWS
• Experience working with Agile methodologies

What you will get in return

A culture where you can thrive..
• An entrepreneurial culture encouraging creativity and innovative, disruptive ideas,
• A diverse and fast-paced work environment and the ability to interact with/learn from a wide variety of specialists,
• A multicultural team promoting our corporate values of Ownership, Transparency, Team spirit, Boldness,
• Workplace automation and application of new technologies across workflows.

Benefits To Support You In Your Journey..
• Internal training and career development opportunities,
• Stock options offerings - our success is your success,
• Flexible working hours, home working options, attractive package after 1 year,
• Ergonomic work equipment and spacious, modern offices located in Girona(We are 5 min walk from the train station)

Selection process
• Stage 1: Video interview with our HR department (45 min)
• Stage 2: Meet the Team: interview with the hiring manager and a senior member of the team (45 min)
• Stage 3: Interview with a member of the management team or another member of the team (Optional) (45 min

jobs_results.title: BackEnd Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Your opportunity
At New Relic, we provide our customers real-time insights, so they can innovate faster. Our software delivers insightful observability tools across different technologies and distributed systems, enabling software engineering teams to quickly identify, understand and tackle issues, analyze performance and get the most of their software and infrastructure.

We work with data at a scale found at few companies using a diverse tech stack (Go, Java, JavaScript, React, GraphQL, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Kubernetes, many public cloud web services, and more). You will work with some of the best engineers and seek some of the most complex problems in the industry.

If you love to scale and want to contribute to one of the largest and fastest-growing observability platforms in the market, we want to hear from you. We are a fast-growing software company that cares about our product and culture!

What you'll do
• Build, maintain, and scale back-end services and their... support tools.
• Participate in architectural definitions with a high degree of innovation and creativity.
• Creating automation and tooling to make our systems more scalable and easier to deploy.
• Working directly within a multidisciplinary team to help our customers and partners.
• Research new tools and services to understand complex scenarios and to also propose new features.
• Working in an agile environment with a DevOps approach—teams build and maintain their own software, including taking turns with being on-call.

This role requires
• Experience with distributed systems, concurrency, and scaling in a production environment.
• Strong experience in writing software in OOP (Java, GO, Python...) and you are not afraid of adapting, learning, and working with different languages and frameworks.
• Familiarity with asynchronous programming techniques: streams, event-based flows, task queues, message queues.
• Being comfortable in a fast-paced environment focused on delivering production code at a regular cadence using Agile techniques, tools and methodologies.
• Having a collaborative work style that includes colleagues in important decisions and leads to shared code ownership.
• Proficiency in English.

Bonus points if you have
• Contribution to open source projects.
• Understanding the value that build and test automation brings to a development team's efficiency and reliability and are passionate about applying these techniques to your projects.
• Experience in technical mentorship and support for helping level up the skills of colleagues on the team.

Fostering a diverse, welcoming and inclusive environment is important to us. We work hard to make everyone feel comfortable bringing their best, most authentic selves to work every day. We celebrate our talented Relics’ different backgrounds and abilities, and recognize the different paths they took to reach us – including nontraditional ones. Their experiences and perspectives inspire us to make our products and company the best they can be. We’re looking for people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruiting process, please visit https://newrelic.avature.net/accommodations to submit your request.

We believe in empowering all Relics to achieve professional and business success through a flexible workforce model. This model allows us to work in a variety of workplaces that best support our success, including fully office-based, fully remote, or hybrid.

New Relic currently has offices in Germany, Ireland, Spain, and the United Kingdom, and based on business needs may approve work in Belgium, France, Italy, The Netherlands, Switzerland, UAE, and other locations throughout the region. Some of our opportunities are limited to specific hiring locations. Talk with your recruiter about your goals.

Our hiring process

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

In compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work and to complete employment eligibility verification. Note: Our stewardship of the data of thousands of customers’ means that a criminal background check is required to join New Relic.

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. New Relic does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with New Relic.

New Relic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We foster a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment, free from all types of discrimination, so our Relics can thrive. We hire people with different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Candidates are evaluated based on qualifications, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, age, disability, neurodiversity, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other legally protected characteristics.

Review our Applicant Privacy Notice at https://newrelic.com/termsandconditions/applicant-privacy-policy

jobs_results.title: Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
About The Company

Ingram Micro touches 80% of the technology you use every day with our focus on Technology Solutions, Cloud, and Commerce and Lifecycle Solutions. With $50 billion in revenue, we have become the world’s largest technology distributor with operations in 64 countries and more than 35,000 associates.

And we are looking for people to build and drive the CloudBlue Monetization Platform. CloudBlue enables companies to succeed in today’s subscription economy by unlocking the power of digital ecosystems and marketplaces. With its pioneering technology, CloudBlue powers the world’s largest cloud B2B marketplaces, and is an industry leader for monetizing B2B cloud subscriptions.

These are our core values:
• Customer Focused
• Our Creative Engine
• Our Trust in the Team
• Our Strive for Excellence
• And Our Passion and Energy

About The Role

We are looking for a Backend Engineer responsible for the development of the Connect platform within the CloudBlue solution. Connect is... a micro-service SaaS platform operating in the Cloud infrastructure which has API interaction, relational and non-relational databases, message broker exchanges, etc.

We are a growing distributed team primarily located in Barcelona with people in Sofia and Irvine CA. We are a diverse group of young and energetic engineers building the cutting-edge tech platform. So if you are looking for the creativity and freedom of a start-up with the stability of a large and established company, let’s get in touch!

What You’ll Be Doing
• Primarily building API and services in Python
• Developing and supporting features from design to production
• Closely working with frontend engineers in small feature teams
• Collaborating with other CloudBlue teams
• Applying tech proposals and enhancements
• Working with your team and engineering manager to grow your career

What You Need
• 3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer
• Experience in Python with 2+ years of experience
• API development and integration expert
• Moderate PostgreSQL and RDBMS knowledge
• Familiar with Docker & Docker Compose
• Basic understanding of the modern frontend tech
• Unit test expert
• Professional working proficiency in English language

Nice To Have
• Django/DRF & FastAPI experience
• Experience with k8s
• Cloud experience with AWS, Azure or GCP
• Experience with IaC, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting
• Open source contribution or a pet project
